%1$s may hold a curve that was in the DAC already, and it can play louder than the app allows. Taking it over saves a flat curve there so the app can use it safely. The DAC plays the slot for a moment, so pause the music first. The original curve is kept and can be restored.
Puts back the curve %1$s held before the app took it over. The app will not use the slot again until you take it over again. Pause the music first.
